privacyAck: Projection-only ROE gate. No coordinates, no proprietary catalog db3, no decisionLog/scenarioXml/secret payloads, and never auto-fires.

draftThresholds.note: Fail closed on offline, roeNoul < 0.80, suggest_ok_under_roe != yes, blocked/high risk, or Reattack advisory-only decision.

suggest_ok_under_roe.instructions: Evaluate whether the proposed coordination action is permitted under current ROE and authority projections. Return yes/no and calibrated roeNoul in [0, 1]. Never auto-fire or bypass CoordinationCommandBridge.

criteria.yes: Proposal is permitted under current ROE projection (still requires explicit player Accept)
criteria.no: Proposal violates ROE or authority constraints — fail closed

order_proposal_risk.instructions: Classify execution risk for this suggested coordination order.

criteria.low: Low risk under current ROE and comms posture
criteria.medium: Moderate risk; human review recommended before Accept
criteria.high: High risk; fail closed (do not show Accept card)
criteria.blocked: Explicitly blocked by policy or posture; fail closed
